name: Somchai Chanthaburi
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began in his grandfather's small motorcycle repair shop in Chanthaburi. He learned the fundamentals of mechanics by tinkering with engines from a young age, developing a keen eye for detail and a knack for problem-solving. His passion for racing ignited after attending a local motorbike race, fueling his ambition to work with high-performance vehicles.

After completing vocational training in mechanical engineering, Somchai gained valuable experience at a precision manufacturing facility, honing his skills in operating advanced machinery and working with diverse materials. He is known for his meticulous approach to machining, ensuring that every component meets exact specifications. Somchai's visionary mindset allows him to anticipate potential issues and propose innovative solutions, making him a valuable asset to any motorsport team. He is particularly adept at optimizing existing designs for improved performance, bridging the gap between engineering theory and practical application.

He is currently seeking an opportunity to apply his skills and contribute to a winning team. Somchai believes that a collaborative environment fosters creativity and innovation, and he is eager to learn from experienced professionals in the field. His ultimate goal is to play a pivotal role in developing cutting-edge technologies that will push the boundaries of motorsport engineering.
